Delete an item, softly; --cascade deletes the items below it too

## Usage

```text
chainmail item delete <id> [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
chainmail item delete it_01jcb7m2k9r8q3v4w5x6y7z8a9
# the item and every item below it
chainmail item delete it_01jcb7m2k9r8q3v4w5x6y7z8b0 --cascade
```

## Flags

```text
      --cascade   also delete every item below it
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
